title: TRANSFORM AND RESAMPLE A VOLUME FILE
description:
Resample a volume file with an arbitrary list of transformations.  You may specify -affine, -warp, and -affine-series multiple times each, and they will be used in the order specified.  For instance, for rigid motion correction followed by nonlinear atlas registration, specify -affine-series first, then -warp.  The recommended methods are CUBIC (cubic spline) for most data, and ENCLOSING_VOXEL for label data.  The parameter <method> must be one of:

CUBIC
ENCLOSING_VOXEL
TRILINEAR

volume_space.description: a volume file in the volume space you want for the output

background.description: use a specified value for locations outside the FoV of the input image or warpfield(s)

source_volume.description: the source volume used when generating the affine

target_volume.description: the target volume used when generating the affine

flirt.description: MUST be used if affine is a flirt affine

affine_series.description: text file containing 12 or 16 numbers per line, each being a row-major flattened affine

source_volume.description: the source volume used when generating the affine

target_volume.description: the target volume used when generating the affine

flirt.description: MUST be used if the affines are flirt affines

fnirt.description: MUST be used if using a fnirt warpfield
